TRAI regulations require legitimate commercial SMS to use full, pre-whitelisted URLs on DLT; unfamiliar links are a strong fraud indicator

verdict.explanation: This is a phishing scam impersonating India Post. Report the message to your mobile network operator (TRAI) by forwarding it to 7575 (SMS) or reporting via your telecom provider's app
Report the phishing attempt to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at cybercrime.gov.in
If you have already clicked the link or entered information, immediately call your bank and freeze your account, then call the national cyber crime helpline 1930

verdict.fraud_type: UPI PIN scam / Fake collect request refund fraud

evidence.claim: Message asks victim to enter UPI PIN

UPI PIN is required only to SEND money, never to RECEIVE it. Fraudsters pose as senders claiming to need PIN to 'accept' or 'confirm receipt', but entering the PIN actually authorises an outgoing payment from the victim's account

Message falsely claims a 'collect request' will return money. NPCI discontinued peer-to-peer UPI collect requests from October 2025 specifically because they were exploited to trick users into approving fraudulent outgoing payments disguised as incoming refunds
Classic refund scam pattern: claims money was sent by mistake and asks victim to 'accept' and enter PIN to get it back

verdict.explanation: This is a classic UPI PIN scam. The sender falsely claims Rs 5000 was sent by mistake and asks you to enter your UPI PIN to 'accept' a collect request and get the money back. In reality, entering your PIN will authorise money to flow OUT of your account to the fraudster, not back to you. UPI PINs are never needed to receive money—only to send it.
actions: Do NOT enter your UPI PIN or respond to this message
Immediately block this contact
If you have already shared your UPI PIN, freeze your account immediately through your bank's net banking portal or by calling your bank
Call the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930 and file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in within 24 hours to maximise recovery chances
Report the fraud to your bank within 3 working days to qualify for full liability protection under RBI's framework (kb:upi_liability_001)
